5.title: Central Bank of Ireland Fines Coinbase Unit €3.25 Million Over Customer Fund Safeguarding Failures
5.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Central Bank of Ireland Fines Coinbase Unit €3.25 Million Over Customer Fund Safeguarding Failures Ireland’s central bank has fined Coinbase Ireland €3.25 million for allowing customer funds to mix with other Coinbase entities’ money and for relying on its US parent to run safeguarding controls. This post Central Bank of Ireland Fines Coinbase Unit €3.25 Million Over Customer Fund Safeguarding Failures first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

6.title: SoFi targets idle crypto cash with interest-bearing tokenized deposit
6.summary: SoFi Technologies has launched an innovative tokenized deposit product that offers an attractive 4.2% annual interest rate. Funds deposited are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for amounts up to $250,000 per depositor. This strategic move enables customers to prepare for crypto acquisitions while still earning interest, rather than letting cash sit idle.
